description: Fast, lightning-charged attacks and quick maneuvers. Trades raw damage for action efficiency and magic defense.

skills.name: Volt Strike
skills.description: A quick lightning-charged strike. Cheap enough to chain with other actions.
skills.ai_instruction: Make a physical attack roll (1d20 + Strength modifier) vs target AC. On hit deal weapon dice + Strength modifier physical damage plus 1d6 flat lightning magic damage. Call apply_damage with combined total. Low cost — can be chained with other skills in the same turn.

skills.name: Surge Step
skills.description: Move with lightning speed, bolstering your magic defenses for 2 rounds.
skills.ai_instruction: Apply Evasive status to actor. Adds Wisdom modifier to magic defense for 2 rounds. Call apply_status with effect='evasive', duration=2, persists=false.

skills.name: Chain Lightning
skills.description: Strike a primary target with lightning that arcs to a second target for reduced damage.
skills.ai_instruction: Make magic attack roll (1d20 + Willpower modifier) vs primary target magic defense. On hit deal 1d10 + Willpower modifier lightning damage to primary target. Then arc to second alive target — no additional roll needed, deal 1d6 + Willpower modifier to secondary target. Call apply_damage twice. On crit primary target: max die + roll + modifier.
